title: Introduction to C#
description: Learn the basics of C# programming including variables, data types, control structures, functions, and object-oriented concepts.

title: Working with SQL Server
description: Understand relational databases, write SQL queries, and work with tables, views, stored procedures, and constraints.

title: Advanced C# Concepts
description: Dive into delegates, events, generics, reflection, async/await, and advanced OOP topics in C#.

title: LINQ Fundamentals
description: Use Language Integrated Query (LINQ) to query collections and databases using method and query syntax.

title: Entity Framework Core
description: Learn how to use EF Core for ORM-based database operations, migrations, and model configuration.

title: Building RESTful APIs
description: Create and consume RESTful Web APIs using ASP.NET Core, routing, controllers, and middleware.
